training_data.photometry: the mock's noisy fluxes (COSMOS2020 depth, native noise; not degraded to LSST)
training_data.n_train: 200000 random objects (seed 42), as set in CNN_photoz-ensemble-popcosmos.ipynb
training_data.filters: COSMOS2020 curves used by pop-cosmos (steppz filters + CFHT u_megaprime_sagem)
